The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the new behaviour, and I didn't run your WH-1 example.

The change is in `DataStore.findStockLevelsByWarehouse` (`DataStore.java`, around line 2107). The query now filters on `s.quantity > 0`, and I updated its doc comment to match. `StockService.getWarehouseStock` uses that query, so it needed no change.

`StockService.getQuantity` is untouched, so asking for the quantity of nuts in WH-1 still answers 0.
